scope: Receive the already independently accepted membrane course through exact merged local importer, without altering app source or requalifying generic importer/trace mechanics.

expect: Explicit file selection previews the 12-question, 4-concept membrane course and attribution before lesson replacement.

Complete first answers for all 12 unique items using canonical option text; deliberately miss ms-1, pt-2, os-2, at-3.
Review reflects exact first-pass 8/12 outcomes, preserves first answers and model when practice occurs.
Practice completes at least the four deliberate misses using each correct option text.
Download notes as actual UTF-8 bytes; course title, attribution, question/prompt, correct explanation and first/practice outcomes belong to membrane input.
Keyboard-reachable import and explicit start control; readable horizontal layout at 390px.
Same exact frozen course passes preview/start and all 12 first-answer steps, with a distinct deliberate-miss pattern.
Review-to-practice-to-review path preserves first-answer history and mastery estimates.
Actual UTF-8 notes download preserves title, original Unicode/units, explanations and session-specific answers.
No stale built-in course text or wrong course title in displayed current lesson/notes.

boundaries: No importer implementation edits or merge/undraft actions.
Do not repeat the other receiver's generic authored-deck, malformed-file, trace archive compatibility or main-composition review.
Do not claim standalone no-network operation beyond the local file session actually observed.
Screenshots are supplementary; native DOM, state-independent answer expectations and actual downloaded bytes establish acceptance.
